note: Main study order (ResEnc -> Primus -> SegMamba -> Swin UNETR). ResEnc fold 0 is the whole-head pilot run (tag 'default'). Training length comes from protocol.TRAINING_SAMPLES once the pilot fixes it. GPU: the queue picks the smallest free GPU that fits peak_GB x 1.15 + 1 GiB (10 GB slice < 20 GB slice < full A100; see queue.fitting_gres). peak_GB = measured torch max_memory_allocated in a training step at the configuration and batch size the model trains with; null = not measured yet -> full A100 only. An explicit 'gres' list overrides.
